title: Look-at-top-5 prompt only displays the eligible units, not all 5 looked-at cards
expected: renderPendingChoiceModal (modals.js:93-107) builds the card row solely from availableMoves resolvePendingChoice entries with params.pickedCardId (i.e. only the filter-eligible units) and never reads pending.revealed, so the blocking 'Choose a card to play' modal shows only Flame Chompers/Immortal Phoenix + 'No'. Caveat: the sidebar action list does render pending.revealed thumbnails (render/actions.js:223-232), but while the modal is up they sit beneath the fixed full-viewport 70%-opaque #choiceOverlay (gameplay.css:695-706, z-index 1500; not in 'targeting' mode since deck cards aren't on the board), in a 220px-max scroll panel — so 'never shown' is slightly overstated, but the modal defect is real.
observed: Engine pendingChoice.revealed listed all 5 ids, but the 'Choose a card to play' modal rendered only Flame Chompers and Immortal Phoenix plus 'No'; the 3 non-unit cards were never shown to the player
